note: One silver beck rises inside the sheltered gorge gully, runs south through the lower moor, and exits only through the south edge into Tanium. The mask covers the complete painted channel, riffles, reflections, wet margins, and water between rocks; the ochre-brown erosion gully farther north is dry and excluded.
One short drop crosses the central upland lip. The mask includes the full falling-water column, foam, splash, spray, and adjacent wash at its base.
